## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short one-*juǎn* digest by [智周](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E5%91%A8), compiled (per the colophon "定水寺沙門智周撰") at the Dìngshuǐsì 定水寺. The Xuzangjing prefixes a sub-title "因明疏抄(略記)" — "Excerpts from the *Yīnmíng* commentary (abbreviated record)". The work is a condensed extract from the *Qián jì* [KR6o0023](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0023) and *Hòu jì* [KR6o0024](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0024), retaining the most important annotations on Kuījī's *Dàshū* [KR6o0008](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0008) in a portable single-volume format.

**Abstract**

The text opens with the same Confucius / Kǒngsāng 空桑 lemma as the *Hòu jì* [KR6o0024](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6o/KR6o0024) — citing Yú Bǎo 于寶 *Sōushén jì* 搜神記 — but in much abbreviated form. The body of the *Shū chāo* runs through Kuījī's *Dàshū* in linear order, retaining only the most pithy of Zhìzhōu's earlier glosses; it is best read alongside the *Qián jì* and *Hòu jì* for which it functions as a compact appendix. The Dìngshuǐsì colophon places the work at one of Zhìzhōu's later residences (he served at multiple Cháng'ān monasteries during his career); composition is in the same general window as the longer "two records", c. 700–723.
